newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: BOURSE CAPITALISATION UP LAST WEEK.
newsitem.headline: BOURSE CAPITALISATION UP LAST WEEK.

text.p: bourse rose to 8.75 billion litas last week from 8.49 billion
litas the previous week, the stock exchange said on Monday.
The bourse also said that the capitalisation of the shares
quoted on the bourse rose to 5.896 billion litas last week from
It also said that the capitalisation of shares not quoted on
the bourse, was 1.353 billion litas while the capitalisation of
government T-bills stood at 1.502 billion litas last week.
